# Brijeshkumar Yadav

Full Stack Engineer

Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience building reliable web products with TypeScript, React, Next.js and NestJS.

## About me

I'm a Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience building web applications, from frontend interfaces to backend services.

I care about how software is built, not just whether it works. I prioritize maintainable architecture, performance, reliable implementations, and thoughtful engineering decisions.

I use agentic coding to accelerate implementation while taking ownership of technical decisions, code quality, and the software I deliver.

## How I started my coding journey

Back in 2020, when schools closed during COVID, I started learning to code.

I had no roadmap, no bootcamp, and no degree. I started with YouTube tutorials and learned by building things, making mistakes, and figuring things out along the way.

In 2021, before finishing school, I landed my first job as a Frontend Engineer.

Over time, I moved into backend development and grew into a Full Stack Engineer.

Now, I'm continuing to build, learn, and explore.
